answer: Elected rabbi permit with rabbinical council attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a permit the council renews after synagogue audits, the zephyr of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a permit the council renews after synagogue audits a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the tide of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the pigment is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
